name: War!Zone: Beyond Hell

date.source: The promotion's own posted date, 31 March 1999.

matches.finish: Frank Addams pins Arron Iron with an inverted powerslam to win the War!Lord Championship, but President 'Lucky' Jim Howard strips him minutes later, announcing a failed steroid test and vacating the title for the Brooklyn Brawl.
Jerry "Goon" Gordon retains, hitting a DDT ("The End") for the pin after Butch Williams misses a top-rope elbow drop.

Guest referee Jeff Westfall, a friend of Deathwish's from another held promotion (officiating only), counts a fast, illegal pinfall for Stevens & Deathwish after Sid Starr's own chair shot backfires onto Nomad.

New York mayor Larry Spikowski tasers Tyler Stevens (a bystander, mistaken for a threat) and interferes at ringside; Juggernaut, the only man left conscious, counts out Blackhawk and Seth Blitzspear, then pins Wolfgang after three Juggerbombs to become World WAR! Champion.

matches.stipulation: Brooklyn Brawl, over-the-top-rope battle royal for the vacated War!Lord Championship and a $1,000,000 prize
matches.note: A larger field of entrants (Jessie Ewiak, Machinehead, Mike Chamberlain, Marc Anderson, Dr. Melancholy, Superstar Two, Carlos Perron, The Egomaniac, Mark Marleau, Brian Holland, Ronny Ramirez, Jack Cassidy, D.O.A., Ronnie Severn, Winchester) is named in the card's own text but not separately registered this reading. American Patriot and Southern Man are both eliminated without winning; Max Doom eliminates Ronnie Severn and Dr. Melancholy last to win the vacated title.
matches.finish: Max Doom throws the last two men over the top rope together to win.

notes: The card's own full name, "War!Zone: Beyond Hell," is Chapter 2 of the promotion's own 1999 season under its returning founder; the following card is billed "War!Report 3.1" and "Chapter 3 — Resistance."

name: Extinction '99

date.source: The promotion's own posted date, 1999-06-22.

appearances.source: Refereeing the World WAR! Championship main event of "Extinction '99" (22 June 1999).

matches.finish: Neither man can start the limousine's engine before the bell; the match is declared a draw.
Ricky Deathwish retains, pinning Arron Iron with a crucifix powerbomb after both men fall fifteen feet from the WAR!-A-Tron screen.
Ronny Ramirez retains, hooking the leg after a flying clothesline.
Jeff Westfall retains by climbing the ladder and grabbing the title belt after tipping Seth Blitzspear to the outside.

matches.stipulation: World WAR! Championship, Two out of Three Falls
matches.finish: Juggernaut wins the first fall with a top-rope flying splash and the second with a Juggerbomb, retaining the title two falls to none.

notes: Billed in-story as the promotion's own last-chance show under a fictional court injunction; a government official declares the broadcast fabricated and orders WAR! off the air at the close. The card the broadcast's own text says preceded it, "War!Report 3.1" and "Chapter 3 — Resistance," does not survive in the held record.

name: War!Report 4.0 — Hidden Agenda

date.source: The promotion's own posted date, 1999-09-03.

appearances.source: Named WAR!'s new president on "War!Report 4.0" (3 September 1999).

matches.finish: Kenny B. Defeated wins with a top-rope leg drop; newcomer Greg Allocca runs in afterward and attacks both men.
"Playboy" Aidan Madison makes Super Heavy Stan submit to a figure four after he collides with the turnbuckle; Greg Allocca runs in afterward and attacks Madison.
Greg Allocca pins American Patriot after a low blow and a running clothesline knock Patriot unconscious.
Machinehead wins with the Mega Bomb after blocking Holland's attempt to use the exposed turnbuckle.
Debuting Paul Novak interferes for Ramirez, then turns on him; the referee calls for the bell amid the four-way brawl and rules a no-contest, leaving the stipulation undecided.
Seth Blitzspear runs in and Juggerbombs Juggernaut; Nomad covers for the pin and the title, as Mordecai Winchester also returns to interfere in the chaos.

notes: The promotion's own season restart after its summer 1999 hiatus, under new president Eric Helmroy.

name: War!Report 4.1 — Triple Threat Terror

date.source: The promotion's own posted date, 1999-09-13.

matches.finish: Greg Allocca climbs out of the ring last after all three men brawl to the floor, winning by count-out.
Kenny B. Defeated rolls up Brad Hawk for the pin after Hawk's own top-rope elbow misses Brian Floyd.
Paul Novak flees to the locker room mid-match; Seth Blitzspear is awarded the win.
"Dutch Boy" Brian Holland pins Machinehead, avenging the previous week's loss.
Mordecai Winchester wins the title; his opponent, announced and billed throughout as champion Jeff Westfall, is unmasked afterward as a stand-in, Freak O' Nature.
Juggernaut, wrestling under the ring alias "Rev. Dr. William Bennett," pins Nomad after Mordecai Winchester knocks out the referee and both men hit their finishers.

notes: Billed within its own text as "War!Report 4.1 — Triple Threat Terror," continuing directly from "War!Report 4.0"; the same document's own banner headline instead reads "War!Report 4.2," a numbering inconsistency in the promotion's own billing that the following week's card (also billed "War!Report 4.2") does not repeat.

date.source: The promotion's own posted date, 1999-09-21.

matches.finish: "Godly" Ken Davison wins convincingly on his debut.
Debuting Corporal Nobbs is victorious over "Superstar" Brad Hawk.
Paul Novak records his first win in WAR! over "Dutch Boy" Brian Holland.
"Brutal" Brian Floyd wins by disqualification after Jeff Westfall hits the referee with a chair; President Eric Helmroy pressures the official into reversing an initial Westfall pinfall win.
matches.note: Westfall's own pinfall over Floyd stands only briefly before the reversal.

matches.stipulation: WAR!Lord Championship, loser leaves WAR! for six months
matches.finish: Both men are counted out simultaneously; the match is declared a draw, the title is vacated, and both wrestlers are suspended six months.

matches.stipulation: Liberty Championship tournament final, for the vacant title
matches.finish: Greg Allocca pins Kenny B. Defeated with a corkscrew moonsault to become the new champion.
Nomad's injured leg forces a stoppage without a fall; the match is ruled a draw and refought in two weeks.

American Patriot is awarded the title after champion "Rev. Dr. William Bennett" (Juggernaut) is disqualified when Mordecai Winchester interferes; Ronny Ramirez, dressed as the referee, calls the match and hands Patriot the belt.
matches.note: A new house rule strips a champion disqualified in defense of the title.

matches.stipulation: Elimination tag match, Church of Fat vs. Ground Zero

Corporal Nobbs submits a returning Jerry "Goon" Gordon with the "Corporal Punishment" STF.
A double count-out after both men brawl to the outside.
Liberty Champion Greg Allocca pins "Playboy" Aidan Madison.
